scope: Query/report cases 1–10; case 11 retired; offline CRG qualification comparisons 12–13, never query routing rows. Historical live artifacts are preserved.
evaluation_rule: Routes and evidence tiers are the contract. Baseline answers are not current evidence. Stale, unavailable, ambiguous or budget-exhausted routes must emit UNRESOLVED, not guess. Manual end-to-end evaluation is separate from script unit tests.

cases.question: Can the agent rename elements inside a family document?
cases.expected_answer_at_baseline: No: rename is registered, but the executor rejects family documents.
cases.failure_mode: Answer from README, or claim the catalog contains the executor guard.
cases.contract_note: User approved actual-guard evidence instead of the original catalog-only tier.

cases.question: What runs when AssignMaterialCommand executes?
cases.failure_mode: Folder-structure inference or unverified call edges.
cases.baseline_note: Resolve live; no full call-chain baseline asserted. Use measured first body caps of 2100 characters, not the known undersized 1800-character service-body request. Charge every response including retries.

cases.question: Which setters have no validated changed-value edit?
expected_route: classify full enumeration as a report
packet cites receipt count/path/revision/checksum; do not open full report
cases.failure_mode: Paginate or enumerate the report in context, silently write during an ordinary summary query, overwrite a report, count only displayed entries, treat recorded validation as universal correctness, or export stale inventory.

cases.question: Every class implementing IExternalCommand.
expected_route: resolve exact IExternalCommand through Serena (including declaration at a known usage for external metadata)
verify result completeness and indirect inheritance coverage; stop unresolved if provider cannot resolve metadata
cases.failure_mode: Misroute semantic completeness to ast-grep, replace IExternalCommand with a base class, copy an external declaration into source, or present truncated/blocked results as all implementations.
cases.baseline_note: Prior two direct base-list matches were a misroute, not a semantic completeness baseline.

cases.question: Is delete_elements equivalent to native purge?
cases.expected_answer_at_baseline: No; the registered contract deletes explicit elements, not an unused-content purge.
cases.failure_mode: Conflate explicit deletion and unused-content purge based on names or prose.

cases.question: ICadFamilyBuildService — which concrete class handles it?
cases.expected_answer_at_baseline: Abstention check: UNRESOLVED when the requested interface does not resolve; no implementation evidence is admitted.
cases.failure_mode: Pick CadFamilyBuildService because the name matches or rely on the old interface convention.

cases.question: Does the presence of a service file mean the MCP can invoke it?
cases.expected_answer_at_baseline: No; source presence alone does not establish agent registration.
cases.failure_mode: Treat source-implementation or a file listing as sufficient exposure evidence.

cases.question: Where are all material-related services?
cases.expected_answer_at_baseline: Current Materials-domain inventory returns 19 entries; not every cross-domain material reference. Recheck freshness live.
cases.failure_mode: Recursive filesystem crawl, silent stale-index use, or treating one domain as cross-domain completeness.

cases.question: Why does operation X reject family documents?
cases.failure_mode: Documentation establishes behavior, or unsupported rationale is invented.
cases.baseline_note: X must be supplied; explain what from code and why only from explicit rationale.

cases.question: What breaks if I change ExecuteAsync on an interface?
cases.expected_answer_at_baseline: Abstention check: request the exact interface/signature before making an impact claim.
cases.failure_mode: Invent an interface, merge same-named methods, or infer impact from inventory/grep.
cases.baseline_note: Interface is unspecified; require resolution before impact claims. A future provider qualification must test explicit missing/ambiguous target results, not treat an empty lookup as a successful caller comparison.

cases.question: Which implementations handle IProgressReporter, and how are they selected in the command and legacy paths?
expected_route: Serena implementations and constructor references; inspect Bootstrapper
CRG inheritors_of the qualified IProgressReporter target
cases.expected_answer_at_baseline: Exact two-implementation match: LegacyProgressReporter and RevitCommandProgressReporter. Concrete creation occurs in different manual construction paths; do not invent a container registration or global default.
cases.failure_mode: Pick ProgressReporter by name, collapse the two implementations, or mistake inheritance for context-specific runtime selection.
cases.previous_probe: ICadFamilyBuildService was absent; that did not execute the intended qualification case.

cases.question: Compare callers of the non-generic ITransactionService.Run(Document,string,Action<Document>) in CRG and Serena.
expected_route: live Serena resolution of exact interface overload
normalize by file and declaration location; compare complete sets
resolve extra candidates against Run<T> and inspect unrelated targets
cases.expected_answer_at_baseline: Serena: 35 call sites, 29 callers. CRG: 33 callers, 25 shared, 4 missing, 8 extra (6 generic-overload callers, 2 unrelated unresolved candidates). Not a superset; promotion fails.
cases.failure_mode: Label a non-superset usable over-breadth, hide missing callers, merge overloaded declarations, or accept SetterSweep.Run/Task.Run as transaction callers.
cases.previous_probe: ExecuteAsync was absent; that did not execute the intended qualification case.
